# Third-party notices

Audacity Video Sync uses and, in binary releases, dynamically bundles open-source software including MPV, FFmpeg and their runtime libraries.

The current release build uses the default Homebrew MPV package and a GPL-enabled FFmpeg configuration. The resulting combined binary distribution is provided under the GNU General Public License version 3 or later.

The full package list, installed versions and SPDX licence expressions are recorded in [DEPENDENCIES.md](DEPENDENCIES.md). Individual upstream licence texts, copyright files, Homebrew formulae and SPDX SBOM records are collected under `Licenses/` by `Scripts/collect_licenses.sh`.

## Principal components

- **MPV** — Copyright the MPV/MPlayer/mplayer2 contributors. GPL-2.0-or-later by default; an LGPL configuration is available upstream.
- **FFmpeg** — Copyright the FFmpeg developers. This Homebrew configuration is GPL-3.0-or-later and includes GPL-enabled components.
- **x264** — GPL-2.0-or-later.
- **x265** — GPL-2.0-or-later.
- **Rubber Band Library** — GPL-2.0-or-later in the Homebrew formula used by this build.

Other bundled components use LGPL, BSD, MIT, Apache, ISC, MPL, FTL, zlib, libpng and related open-source licences. Their original notices and terms remain applicable.

No ownership of third-party software is claimed. No additional restriction is imposed on reverse engineering for the purpose of debugging modifications to LGPL-covered components.

## Corresponding source

Every public binary release should be accompanied on the same GitHub Release page by:

- the repository source associated with the release tag; and
- `Audacity-Video-Sync-X.Y-Third-Party-Source.tar.gz`, generated by `Scripts/prepare_release_compliance.sh`.

The third-party archive contains the exact upstream source archives and Homebrew patch files recorded by the installed SPDX SBOMs, together with formula, SBOM and licence metadata.

## Independent project

Audacity itself is not bundled. Audacity Video Sync communicates with an independently installed copy of Audacity through its scripting interface. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Audacity, Muse Group, MPV or FFmpeg.
